feed.title: Microsoft FastTrack: new and updated resources
feed.subtitle: The 20 most recently updated tools, guides, agents, and scripts in the FastTrack catalog.

entry.title: Microsoft Agent 365 Customer Implementation Guide (v1.3.0)
entry.summary: Plan and configure a governed Microsoft Agent 365 baseline with simple guidance and detailed implementation tasks.

entry.title: Agents Cost Calculator (v2.0.0)
entry.summary: Estimate production, test, and purchase-commitment costs for Copilot Studio, Agent Builder, SharePoint, and Foundry agents.

entry.title: Agent 365 Lifecycle Atlas (v1.3.0)
entry.summary: Explore Agent 365 lifecycles, discovery, identity, tooling, telemetry, admin actions, and 18 public API endpoints in one atlas.

entry.title: Copilot Analytics Reports Navigator (v1.0.0)
entry.summary: Compare 21 Microsoft reports and 22 public community projects by purpose, metrics, location, timing, and release status.

entry.title: Copilot Agents Guide (v4.0.1)
entry.summary: Compare Microsoft Copilot agent approaches, availability, licensing, FastTrack scope, and common scenarios.

entry.title: ESS ServiceNow ITSM Get Request Details (v1.0.0)
entry.summary: Extend the Employee Self-Service agent to look up ServiceNow service catalog requests (REQ) and request items (RITM).

entry.title: ESS ServiceNow ITSM Get User Requests (v1.0.0)
entry.summary: Extend the Employee Self-Service agent to list a user's open, closed, or all ServiceNow service catalog requests (REQ).

entry.title: Add-EngageGroupAdmins (v1.0.0)
entry.summary: Bulk-add owners (admins) to Viva Engage communities from a CSV by using the Microsoft Graph group owners API.

entry.title: Delete-AllCommunityPosts (v1.0.0)
entry.summary: Delete every message in a Viva Engage community; dry run by default, optional CSV backup, and deletion can't be undone.

entry.title: Delete-EngageGroups (v1.0.0)
entry.summary: Bulk-delete Viva Engage communities from a CSV through Microsoft Graph; dry run by default and deletion can't be undone.

entry.title: Delete-EngageUsers (v1.0.0)
entry.summary: Bulk-remove users from Viva Engage communities from a CSV through Microsoft Graph; dry run by default, accounts are not deleted.

entry.title: Export-EngageFiles (v1.0.0)
entry.summary: Export files uploaded to a Viva Engage network during a date range by using the Yammer Files Export API.

entry.title: Export-EngageNetworkData (v1.0.0)
entry.summary: Export Viva Engage network messages and files for a date range by using the Network Data Export API.

entry.title: Get-AllInsightsLicensedUsers (v1.0.0)
entry.summary: Export Entra users licensed for Viva Insights, with manager and department, to build the organizational data file.

entry.title: Get-EngageGroupInfo (v1.0.0)
entry.summary: Report every Viva Engage community's IDs, member count, and admins to CSV by using Microsoft Graph.

entry.title: ProductQuote Agent (v1.0.0)
entry.summary: Generate product quotes from Excel inventory, populate a Word template, and email the finished document.

entry.title: Migrate-CopilotStudioAgents (v1.0.0)
entry.summary: Inventory and copy classic Copilot Studio agents into department-mapped Power Platform environments with ownership recovery.

entry.title: Purview Audit Copilot Report (v1.0.0)
entry.summary: Analyze Copilot adoption by user, app, agent, department, and trend using Purview audit and Entra export data.

entry.title: Copilot Interaction Report (v1.0.0)
entry.summary: Export Copilot interaction history from Microsoft Graph and build a self-contained HTML usage dashboard without Power BI.

entry.title: PowerClaw Agent (v1.2.11)
entry.summary: A 24/7 AI chief of staff with autonomous briefings, task execution, and proactive coordination.
